name: AI Assistant
description: The main Friday agent. Runs a provider-neutral tool loop with system prompts, context compaction, pre-run safety hooks, and memory across sessions.
highlights: Any configured chat provider and model
Pre-run policy hooks block unsafe requests
Per-agent startup files and persistent memory

name: Speech to Text
description: Live dictation and audio transcription. Streams 24 kHz PCM audio from the microphone and returns partial and final transcript events in real time.

name: Text to Speech
description: Synthesize spoken audio from assistant responses. Configurable voice, format, and streaming style through any TTS-capable provider.
highlights: Any configured TTS provider and model

name: Image Creator
description: Generate and edit images from prompts or reference assets. Supports any image-capable provider with normalized result records.
highlights: Provider-specific adapters behind a shared API

name: Video Creator
description: Create videos via async generation jobs. Supports prompt-to-video, reference assets, duration, and aspect ratio through any video-capable provider.
highlights: Prompt, duration, and aspect ratio inputs
Webhook and download support in adapters

name: Music Creator
description: Generate music, sound effects, and audio from text prompts. Covers any provider with music or audio generation capability.

name: Document OCR
description: Extract text from images and documents via a configured OCR endpoint. Validates image input, posts to the endpoint, and returns extracted text.
highlights: Base64 image input with MIME type

name: Cron Scheduler
description: Schedule recurring tasks, one-time runs, and interval jobs with timezone support, missed-run handling, concurrency policies, and full audit trails.
highlights: Cron expression, interval, and one-time schedules
Missed-run policies: skip, run-once, catch-up, fail
Agent turn, image, video, sound, and reminder tasks

name: Background Tasks
description: Run agent, OCR, image, video, and sound work concurrently. Each task has a lifecycle, progress tracking, cancellation via AbortSignal, and in-memory result storage.
highlights: Lifecycle events: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled
